decision: Do not correct implausible continuous outliers using mode, mean, median, or other central tendency imputation. At Stage 0, flag only. At Stage 1, correct only when a clinically and technically justified unit-conversion rule is documented; otherwise set the implausible value to missing while retaining the patient unless cohort eligibility or outcome definition is affected.
rationale: Mode/central-tendency replacement invents patient-level values and can distort associations. Continuous echo/body-size measurements require either documented unit correction or missing-value handling, not categorical-style recoding.
approved_by: approved by project lead; pending clinician/statistician confirmation for any unit-conversion rule
notes: Applies to BMI, Weight, LV Mass, LV Mass Index, IVS, PW, and similar continuous variables. Do not drop entire patients solely because one non-outcome covariate is implausible.

decision: Outcome, administrative, and follow-up support variables must not be used as predictors.
rationale: Prevents outcome leakage and preserves clear separation between predictors, outcomes, censoring, and administrative audit variables.
notes: Applies to event, event_1y, time_to_event_years, data_cutoff_date, and raw administrative support fields.

decision: Use days_echo_to_dialysis as the single canonical echo-to-dialysis timing covariate for Stage 1.
rationale: Avoids duplicate or inverse timing variables in the same model and creates a single interpretable convention.
notes: Negative values indicate echo before dialysis. Exclude months_echo_to_dialysis, months_dialysis_to_echo, and gap_echo_to_dial_days from Stage 1 models.

decision: RVSize, RVSystolicFunction, and AorticValveRegurgitation are exploratory/sensitivity variables only due to high effective missingness.
rationale: Variables with effective missingness above 50% are not appropriate as regular main-model candidates unless explicitly clinician-approved for a dedicated analysis.
notes: Do not include these in the main Stage 1 model.

decision: Do not include GFR and creatinine-numeric result together in the same base model.
rationale: They represent overlapping renal-function information and may introduce collinearity/overadjustment.
notes: Retain creatinine-numeric result as core clinical covariate in the main base model; keep GFR for alternative/sensitivity model.

decision: SBP and DBP variables are sensitivity/descriptive covariates only, not default main-model covariates.
rationale: Both have missingness above the preferred main-model threshold and should not reduce the main analytic sample.
notes: Applies to sbp-numeric result and dbp-numeric result.

decision: years_since_MI is exploratory/descriptive only and must not be used in the main model.
rationale: The variable is structurally missing among patients without MI and would condition on a prior event/subgroup.
notes: May be used only in MI subgroup/exploratory description if clinically useful.

decision: Apply clinician-approved category grouping rules in Stage 1 for selected categorical echocardiography variables. Preserve original variables; create grouped variables with a _clin_grouped suffix. Use grouped versions for main modeling where eligible. Rare categories marked by clinicians as 'ignore' will not be treated as independent model levels; they will be flagged as Rare/ignored or set to missing in analysis-specific datasets while preserving original values.
rationale: Clinician review identified sparse echo categories requiring clinically meaningful merging before modeling. Grouping reduces sparse-cell instability while preserving clinical interpretation and avoids outcome-driven recoding.
approved_by: clinician review document + project lead approval; pending final external sign-off if required
